observations: Revised AS-08 (submission 117597) achieved 0.9082679372, an improvement of +0.0078947368 (+0.7895 percentage points) over the broken AS-08 (117501: 0.9003732004).
Server execution time increased from 236s (3분 56초) to 327s (5분 27초), confirming that Dense inference was actively executing on the server.

However, 0.9082679372 remained -0.0039473684 (-0.3947 percentage points) lower than AS-06/AS-07 (0.9122153056), confirming that turning OFF catalog_full_ko_map and removing the manual dictionary harmed baseline coverage on known names.
Subsequent submission AS-09 (117799, 0.9201100425) with DPR-SYMPHON-02 and catalog_full_ko_map preserved outperformed this revised AS-08 by +0.0118421053 (+1.1842 percentage points).
interpretations: Direct causal confirmation of the AS-08 packaging diagnosis: fixing the missing loss.py immediately restored Dense matching and gained +0.7895%p.

Confirms that Dense alone without high-confidence lexical knowledge (ko_map) left a gap (-0.3947%p vs AS-06), which AS-09 successfully closed and exceeded (+0.7895%p over AS-06) by unifying DPR-SYMPHON-02 with full lexical-dense hybrid synergy.
limitations: Private test inputs and ground truth remain blind.
Breakdown between Hangul and non-Hangul accuracy remains unobserved.
decision: Record SUB-117597 as vital historical ablation evidence confirming that Dense activation recovered +0.7895%p, while retaining AS-09 as the project's best verified submission.
